🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* Supreme Court of India & Central Electricity Regulatory Commission \(CERC\)
• *Announcement:* The Supreme Court declined an interim stay on CERC's proposed power market coupling framework, allowing the regulator to proceed with drafting and implementing new rules for a unified price discovery system\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH \(90\% \- Supreme Court's refusal of an interim stay and CERC's mandate to proceed are explicit official actions\.\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* Infrastructure \(Power Exchanges\)
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Regulatory uncertainty and the potential erosion of dominant market share for existing power exchanges could lead to short\-term investor caution\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Indian fund managers should review their exposure to power exchange operators, especially given the upcoming structural changes in price discovery, and monitor CERC's final regulations\.
